terminals.name: regimen-server
terminals.description: REGIMEN PWA + API server on port 3117. Startup logs print the sign-in URL (with the auto-generated access token) needed to reach /api/* routes.

terminals.name: regimen-readiness
terminals.description: Waits for the server to accept connections, then prints a readiness banner reporting whether Web Push is armed (REGIMEN_CONTACT set) or disabled. Exits 0 once ready, 1 on timeout.
